notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Orthion by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Biovisionary with haste.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, as well as Orthion five times.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.
